hardware_source: Frozen U126 L512 from the verified 2026-11-03 release; no research candidate merged.
provenance_note: The project source snapshot and U126 overlay are supplied for rebuilding. The exact upstream commit used for the prebuilt board libraries was not recoverable; source rebuilds are not claimed to be bit-identical to those libraries.
source_selection: llama.cpp core, build modules, tools, vendor dependencies, grammars and runtime scripts. Upstream development infrastructure, examples, tests, manuals, media, and the disabled UI frontend are omitted. Required native UI embed/build helpers are retained. The supplied options build the API server without an embedded browser UI.
